fact: The "Line height" control in the properties panel has presets "Tight" = 1.0, "Normal" = 1.25 and "Loose" = 1.5 plus a field that accepts a typed value from 0.8 to 2.5 in steps of 0.05; it is shown when a text, a shape with text or an arrow label is selected or the Text tool is active, and has no keyboard shortcut.

fact: In the "Line height" field, values below 0.8 become 0.8, values above 2.5 become 2.5, values between steps round to the nearest 0.05, both "." and "," work as decimal separator, and empty or non-numeric input keeps the previous value.

fact: New text keeps its font's own line height until a line height is chosen, after which the last chosen value is the default for new text; a chosen line height is kept when the font family changes, while a never-changed text follows its new font's own line height.

fact: With several texts at different line heights selected, no "Line height" preset is highlighted and the field is empty; a preset click or a typed value sets that line height on all of them, and a value matching no preset highlights no preset.

fact: Changing the line height of text inside a shape changes the shape's height while its width stays the same; an arrow label stays at the middle of the arrow; a sticky note's auto-fit takes line height into account so the label never overflows the note.
